title: Playing Video Games
summary: Learn simple English for talking about video games: where you play, what kind of game you like, why you like it, and how friends choose a game together.

cover.alt: English lesson illustration for Playing Video Games

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Video games are a normal hobby for many people. You learn simple English for platforms, game types, friends, and safe habits. You also see a few real examples before practicing a longer conversation between two friends choosing a game.

items.prompt: Do you play games on a phone, computer, console, or tablet?
Do you like playing alone or with friends?
What kind of game is fun for you?

blocks.title: 1. Where People Play
paragraphs: People can play video games on different platforms. A platform is the place or device you use to play. A phone is easy to carry. A computer can be good for many online games. A console connects to a TV or screen. A tablet can feel simple and relaxed. Some people play for a short time. They play one quick game on the train or at home. Other people play for a longer time with friends. The important English is simple: name the platform, name the game, and say when you play.

images.alt: English lesson illustration for Playing Video Games scene 1: Who Plays Video Games?

items.answer: A platform is the place or device you use to play a game.
items.explanation:
I usually play on my phone.
I play on a computer.
I play on a console.
I do not play games often.

Look back at this section and find the main reason.

What platform do you usually use?

blocks.title: Useful Speaking Patterns: Platforms
paragraphs:
- Which platform should we use?
- Let's play on...
- I can play on my tablet.
- I can play on my computer.

blocks.title: 2. Kinds of Games
paragraphs: There are many kinds of games. In an action game, players move quickly and make fast choices. In a sports or racing game, players can play soccer, basketball, or car races. In an adventure game, players explore new places and find useful items. Real examples help. Minecraft is a building and survival game: players use blocks to make houses, farms, or whole worlds. Mario Kart is a racing game: players drive, use items, and try to finish first. Animal Crossing is a calm life game: players decorate, catch fish, and visit neighbors. The Legend of Zelda is an adventure series: players explore, find tools, and solve puzzles.

images.alt: English lesson illustration for Playing Video Games scene 2: Action And Sports Games

items.prompt: Name two real game examples from this section and their game types.
items.answer: Minecraft is a building and survival game, and Mario Kart is a racing game. Animal Crossing is a calm life game, and The Legend of Zelda is an adventure series.
items.explanation:
I like Minecraft because I can build.
I like Mario Kart because it is exciting.
I like Animal Crossing because it is calm.
I like The Legend of Zelda because I can explore.

Look back at this section and find the main reason.

Which real game or game type do you like best?

blocks.title: Useful Speaking Patterns: Game Types
paragraphs:
- What kind of game do you want to play?
- I like Minecraft because I can build.
- I like Mario Kart because it is exciting.
- I like Animal Crossing because it is calm.

blocks.title: 3. Playing with Friends
paragraphs: Some games are single-player games. One person plays alone. This can be good when you want quiet time. Some games are team games. Friends work together, talk, help each other, and make a plan. Playing with friends needs simple communication. Friends can choose the game, agree on the time, and decide if they want voice chat or short messages. Good game English is friendly, clear, and not too long.

images.alt: English lesson illustration for Playing Video Games scene 3: Adventure And Building Games

items.prompt: What do friends do in team games?
items.answer: Friends work together, talk, help each other, and make a plan.
items.explanation:
I prefer single-player games because...
I prefer team games because...
It depends on the game.

Look back at this section and find the main reason.

Do you prefer single-player games or team games?

blocks.title: Useful Speaking Patterns: Playing with Friends
paragraphs:
- Do you want to play a game later?
- Can we play without voice chat today?
- We can use short messages.
- That works for me.

blocks.title: 4. Choosing a Good Game
paragraphs: Friends do not always want the same game. One friend may want a fast game like Mario Kart. Another friend may want a calm game like Animal Crossing or a building game like Minecraft. It is useful to explain the reason, not only the game name. Friends can also make a small plan before they start. They choose the platform, choose the game type, choose the time, and choose one rule for playing safely.

images.alt: English lesson illustration for Playing Video Games scene 4: Team Games And Friends and 5. Why People Like Games

items.prompt: What four things can friends choose before they play?
items.answer: They can choose the platform, game type, time, and one safe rule.
items.explanation:
I would choose a calm game.
I would choose a team game.
I would play for thirty minutes.
I would take a break after one round.

Look back at this section and find the main reason.

What game would you choose with a friend today?

blocks.title: Useful Speaking Patterns: Choosing and Closing
paragraphs:
- I want something relaxing today.
- I want something exciting today.
- Not Mario Kart tonight.
- Maybe Minecraft in creative mode.
- Let's play for thirty minutes.
- I need a break after this round.
- See you then.
- Talk to you later.

blocks.title: Final Reflection
paragraphs: Video-game English does not need to be complicated. You can name the platform, name the kind of game, give one reason, and make a small plan with a friend.
When you talk about games in English, try this order: what game, what platform, why you like it, how long you can play, and one friendly rule.
